rule_a.formula: for every requested interest i: n_i >= d

rule_b.formula: union_support(requested_interests) >= d * m and sum(n_i across requested_interests) >= d * m
rule_b.union_computation_rule: Compute exact set union of matching canonical place_ids across requested interests directly rather than assuming zero multi-interest overlap forever.

CLEAR.definition: Passes Rule A and Rule B, and every requested interest i satisfies n_i >= d * m.

EXCLUDED.definition: Fails Rule A or Rule B.

STRESS.definition: Passes Rule A and Rule B, and at least one requested interest i satisfies d <= n_i < d * m.
